Every %1$d signed days in a row earn a %2$d-hour fee-free window, and every %3$d days a %4$d-day one. It starts only when you tap Activate. A position opened inside an activated window pays no fee, even if it closes later.
Run %1$d m on the roof to unlock the day, then sign CLOCK IN with your wallet. Only signed UTC days count; miss one and the streak starts over.
Free strategies pay %1$d%% only on realized profit; losses pay nothing. Pro costs %2$s SOL once and pays 0%%. Both carry a %3$d%% royalty on resale.
Hard limits: %1$s SOL per position, %2$s SOL per day, stop after %3$d losses in a row or %4$s SOL lost in a day. You can only set them lower on the desk.
The last fee payment is still being confirmed. Try again in a few minutes.
Closed while the app was in the background: %1$d · P&L %2$s SOL (simulated on real prices).

Your streak, agents, fee ledger and chat history stay on this phone. Messages you send to Sol go to our AI relay and its model providers (Featherless, Google Gemini) only to get a reply; the relay does not store them. Public chain records (signatures, NFTs, fee transfers) cannot be erased.
Delete all data on this phone?
This wipes your streak, fee-free windows, agents list, fee ledger, desk, chat history, notification settings and the saved wallet session. Your wallet and anything already on chain are not touched.
All app data on this phone was deleted.
Calls from numbers outside your contacts can be silenced or declined. Contacts always ring: Solarchik never reads your contacts. Each screened call is logged here, on this phone.
The call still comes in and stays in your call log, it just does not ring.
The call is rejected. It stays in your call log and you get a missed-call note.
AI note per screened call ($%1$s from credit)
Out of credit: AI notes are paused until you top up.
Opens your Solana wallet with a mainnet USDC payment request. After you approve it, tap Check payment. Credit pays for AI notes only.
No AI note: out of credit.
AI note failed. The call was still handled.

Android will ask you to pick Solarchik as the call screening app. It only sees numbers that are not in your contacts and only the number itself, never the conversation. You can turn it off here or in system settings at any time.
Payment not found yet. Give it a minute and check again.
Could not reach the secretary. Try again later.
Forward unanswered calls to Sol secretary

Your carrier does the forwarding, not the app: each button opens the dialer with a standard GSM code and you press call. People in your contacts still ring normally (call screening never touches them), and calls you do not pick up go to the secretary number. Your carrier may charge for forwarded calls.
No secretary number set. Enter it in international format (+ and country code), or the Sol secretary number +380914810885.
Use international format: + and country code, 8–15 digits.
Turn on (one code at a time)
These are GSM codes. CDMA networks and some carriers use different codes or need forwarding set in their app; if a code fails, ask your carrier.
No dialer on this device. The code was copied.
